candidateDefinition: Recommendation-visible standalone or point-of-interest destination records surfaced by the frozen KAI-151 thematic candidate/exposure audit; hubs and already-sufficient records are retained for classification but are not mutated.
selectionMethod: Frozen five-duration recommendation exposure (shortOuting, halfDay, fullDay, 2d1n, 3d2n) across Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka origins, filtered to the thematic signal and reviewed against destination-specific official operator, municipal, prefectural, or official tourism evidence.

records.name: Chuo Alps Quasi-National Park

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone alpine destination with a detailed official four-season guide and an explicit summer hiking/flower peak.

officialEvidence.authority: Central Alps Komagatake Ropeway official operator
observations: The operator says the Central Alps offer outdoor enjoyment all year, labels summer July-August as the short high-mountain season with alpine flowers and hiking, autumn September-October, and winter November-March.

records.decisionNote: Use the explicit July-August alpine-flower/hiking peak while retaining meaningful all-season suitability.

records.name: Hakuba Iwatake Mountain Resort

seasonMetadata.basis: No defensible four-season suitability vector was verified for this destination; unknown is preserved rather than inferred from scenery or climate.

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone mountain resort with official green and winter operations plus seasonal mountain scenery.

officialEvidence.authority: Hakuba Iwatake Mountain Resort official operator
observations: The operator publishes 2026 green-season operation from April 23 through November 15 and describes spring/summer, autumn three-tier foliage, and winter snow scenery; the winter page documents the snow field and winter season.

records.decisionNote: The preferred months are the central summer portion of the published green season; year-round vector values reflect the operator’s four-season positioning.

records.name: Happo Pond

seasonMetadata.basis: No defensible four-season suitability vector was verified for this destination; unknown is preserved rather than inferred from scenery or climate.

records.cohortReason: High-exposure alpine lake POI with official summer trekking and lift guidance.

observations: The official hiking guide calls Happo-one a summer resort, describes the Happo Pond lift approach and alpine plants, and directs visitors to current summer lift operation information.

records.decisionNote: Summer is the explicit hiking/flower peak; winter suitability is kept low because the pond trail is not a winter default.
